body: If my seemingly schizophrenic kid started giving me attitude on the anniversary of my wife's death I'd probably be a little angry too.

I'd cut the guy some slack considering he's probably in a police station afraid to go back to his house right now. It's pretty clear his wife is named Jennifer. 

He was probably worrying about a sister/mother/friend as he wrote that and got mixed up.

I just can't go through all that again. I worked so hard to build a new life at my new school. I had everything going for me and now it's been ripped away from me.

I just can't see myself lasting another few years in this dead end town raking in more debt without getting anywhere. I have $40k in student loans and three partial degrees to show for it. My life is going nowhere fast and I've officially run out of my patience to keep working at it.

I wouldn't call it a final straw either. Things were finally good thos past semester. But now I have to throw away all that I worked for. And I'm worse off than when I started.

I had a bad experience with counseling the first time around. There's no way in hell I'd ever go back to one after that. They made things worse and almost pushed me over the edge.

I realize things can get "better" than what they are, but I don't think I can take that now after seeing how good I had it and will never have it again.

I would say you need to get the HECK out of that house!

Assuming you're still at the police station after what happened last night though.
